headline: The watch learns to stand its ground
lede: ASTEROIDS shipped the kiting dance: the pilot now flies the money game the cabinet pays best — draw the saucer, beat its fire, and bank the 200/1000 bounty. Verified end to end by the resumed slot-b lane: 136 sim gates, 10/10 live-seat drives, zero page errors.

notes.text: #3706 shipped in 50f73b4 — rollout pays SAUCER×1.2 onto the rocks' ledger and the hull threat reuses the rock law's own 45-tick margin, so the crosshair stays on the bounty instead of fleeing at 75. Measured: 14 saucer kills / zero deaths across ten seated seeds vs 5 under the old docked law.

This slot resumed its own corpse: the predecessor died after opening PR #3717 but before merging. Everything it claimed was re-verified at the pushed sha before merging — check, drive, lint gates, main-ok — and the survival floor was re-read untouched: no candidate is ever bought into a death.

smoke failed once on the PR head (advisory): rerun launched, not waited on, and a triage note handed to QA pass #3730 — along with the dance's two player-visible tells: bounty credit popups with a saucer-pitch ping, and an ON AUTO/MANUAL who-is-flying indicator.
Warden TARGET #3689 skipped honestly: step 1b found half-built #3706 on this slot and resume outranks claim; #3689 itself went to the QA lane mid-shift.
